description: React component implementing a hover menu with customizable position ('left' or 'top'), styled with styled-components, handling hover state via callbacks, and rendering children elements.

classes.name: HoverMenu
classes.description: A React PureComponent that renders a styled hover menu with configurable position and hover callbacks.

methods.name: handleMouseEnter
methods.description: Triggers on hover start, calls onHover callback with isHovered true.

methods.name: handleMouseLeave
methods.description: Triggers on hover end, calls onHover callback with isHovered false.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the styled hover menu container with children elements.
